provenance.client: global fetch, POST, streamed Readable body, duplex half, no dispatcher (the WorkerClient.publishCheckpoint path)
provenance.server: Go net/http over TLS with HTTP/2, WriteTimeout 1s, handler read the full 262144-byte body then slept 2s; the server closed the stream at its write deadline
provenance.note: global fetch negotiated h2 by default; the same chain came out with an explicit undici Agent allowH2. The h1 server produced UND_ERR_SOCKET instead.
